name: Time Letter
source:
It's the last day of high school, and your club mates have decided to start exchanging letters instead of ''instant messages'', the club member who suggests this idea says it's to test your bond as a club since you all going on different paths in college.

You're hesitant at first but decide to go along with it.

''Receive, reply or ignore your old friend's letters''

Choose how you reply as you observe your old friends forge their road in life

What does await you at the end of your path ?

Life in solitude?  

Dating a cute girl in college ?

Or..

Maybe ...

just maybe.

''A Happy ending'' ?

[From [url=https://fouzi94.itch.io/time-letter]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
高中最后一天，社团成员们决定开始互通信件，而不再发“即时消息”。提出这个主意的成员说，大家即将各奔前程、进入大学，借此可以考验社团情谊。

你起初有些犹豫，但还是决定接受这个提议。

“收下、回复，或置之不理——面对老朋友的来信，由你决定。”

看着老朋友们踏上人生道路，选择你要如何回信。

你的旅途终点会有什么在等着你？

孤独终老？

在大学里和可爱的女孩约会？

或者……

也许……

真的只是也许。

迎来“幸福结局”？

[摘自[url=https://fouzi94.itch.io/time-letter]Itch.io[/url]]
